heard: Just after someone presses a button, a product keeps its promise, or quietly breaks it. What decides it is rarely on the screen. We build both sides of that moment. Automation carries the busy work, and a person still approves what matters. Releases go out on an ordinary afternoon, and nobody holds their breath. When a storage node goes dark in EG's store, the files keep coming back, verified. Good engineering rarely asks to be noticed. It simply holds. Cloud fire.
